narr: A long-duration severe weather event occurred from the late morning hours of Tuesday, January 3rd to the early morning hours of Wednesday, January 4th. Several rounds of rain and thunderstorms impacted Central Alabama, producing tornadoes, damaging straight-line winds, quarter size hail, and flooding.
ev: Several locations along Valleydale Road and Cahaba Valley Road impassable due to high water.
Highway 411 in Odenville at the intersection of Old Springville Road flooded and impassable.
